line.en: the christmas market in the distillery district opens with the tree lighting at 18:00. free before 16:00; paid tickets apply at peak hours, including opening night.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt im distillery district öffnet mit der baumbeleuchtung um 18:00. vor 16:00 ist der eintritt frei; zu den stoßzeiten, auch am eröffnungsabend, gibt es bezahlte tickets.
line.tr: distillery bölgesindeki noel pazarı, saat 18:00'deki ağaç ışıklandırmasıyla açılıyor. 16:00'dan önce giriş ücretsiz; açılış gecesi dahil yoğun saatlerde ücretli bilet gerekiyor.

sparks.why: Distillery Winter Village 2026 opening and tree lighting, Thu 12 Nov 18:00, running to 3 Jan 2027 (newswire.ca release; todocanada listing).
